title: A Bottle of Dew
subject: English
summary: “A Bottle of Dew” is a story about a rich but lazy man named Rama Natha. He believed that there was a magic potion that could make him richer. His wife, Madhumati, was worried about him and asked a wise man named Mahipati to help. Mahipati told Rama Natha that he could make a magic potion using dew drops collected from banana leaves. He asked him to collect a bottle full of dew drops. Rama Natha started planting banana trees, watering them and collecting dew drops every morning. His wife also helped him. After working hard for several years, he collected a full bottle of dew and took it to Mahipati. Mahipati then explained that there was no magic in the bottle. It was his hard work that had made him wealthy. Rama Natha understood the value of hard work and patience. The story teaches us that hard work is the real magic and there is no shortcut to success.
